name: comp-307
blurb: Dark feature launch banner with icon, message, download and link buttons.
description: Full-width dark-themed feature launch banner with eclipse icon, message, Download primary button, Learn more link-style button, and dismissible close.
use_when: You need to launch a feature with prominent download action and secondary learn option.
avoid_when: For single-action announcements; use simpler banners instead.
a11y: Close button has aria-label; icons are aria-hidden. Component uses useState to manage visibility.
